subject: [PATCH RFC v4 10/12] mm/gup: pass an end address to follow_page_mask() and return a page count

2026-07-24.patch_summary: This patch modifies the follow_page_mask() function in the mm/gup module to return the number of contiguous pages covered by a page, rather than a bitmask representing the enclosing huge page. The function now takes an additional 'end' argument that bounds how far the walk looks, allowing for more efficient handling of large folios and preventing unnecessary scanning. This change is intended to facilitate batching PTE-mapped large folios in a later patch without introducing functional changes.
